items.summary: Add clear hover, focus, and selected (active) visual states for all tab buttons in the Success Criteria module (the four success criteria tabs plus the “Impact” and “90-Day Plan” buttons), so users can visually tell what is interactive, what is hovered, and what is selected.

Ensure the “Impact” and “90-Day Plan” controls in the Success Criteria module are clearly separated as two distinct buttons (not visually merged/overwritten) and that each triggers only its respective scroll target (Impact scrolls to the Impact section; 90-Day Plan scrolls to the Roadmap section).
